title: Highberg is the least-resolved firm in the pilot: its positioning cannot be scored without a call
content:
The research names Highberg the least-resolved firm in the pilot and says everything about its positioning needs a call. Its verticals are recorded as unclear, its Dutch profile is empty, revenue is unavailable and its stack was not researched. The rank it carries came from a mechanical rescore of a provisional v2 tail row on size and slot occupancy alone.

What distinguishes this row from the other unscored ones is the instrument the flag prescribes. Most of them defer to an OSS-portfolio screen, which is desk work against published material. Highberg is sent to a call instead, which is a statement that desk research has already been tried and did not resolve the firm.

That makes the cheapest resolution a short qualification conversation, and it makes the current rank unusable in the meantime. Until the call happens, Highberg should not compete for outreach capacity against leads whose verticals and stacks are actually on record.
